title: geonoma maxima subsp. camptoneura
intro: Geonoma maxima subsp. camptoneura, commonly known as the Camptoneura Geonoma Palm, is a plant species within the Arecaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Geonoma maxima subsp. camptoneura include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, fever, and infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antispasmodic, and antiparasitic effects.
